text:
Predicates:
BredBack(x) ::: x is a form of artificial selection by the deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is Heck cattle.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Aurochs(x) ::: x is an aurochs.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Extinct(x) ::: x is extinct.
FOL ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.

Premises:
BredBack(breedingBack) ::: Breeding back is a form of artificial selection by the deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
HeckCattle(heckCattle) ∧ Resemble(heckCattle, aurochs) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s to resemble the aurochs.
Animal(heckCattle) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Animal(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x ∃y (Animal(x) ∧ BredBack(x) ∧ Animal(y) ∧ Extinct(y) ∧ Resemble(x, y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.

Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ BredBack(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
